summary: Modular monolith: Django + Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL serving React + Vite (SPA) (web) + React Native (Expo) for Android, hosted on Google Cloud Run (asia-south1 Mumbai). Estimated $820-3,600/month (around the $1,500 budget).

architecture_rationale.text: One deployable with strict internal modules for the ai_ml_product domain: a 4-engineer team gets clear boundaries without distributed-system overhead; modules can be extracted later if scale demands it. The ML model is deployed as a separate service so it can be retrained and scaled independently. Over-engineering guard: microservices rejected: 4 engineer(s), no DevOps cannot absorb the operational overhead.

frontend.choice: React + Vite (SPA) (web) + React Native (Expo) for Android
frontend.justification: Web - React + Vite (SPA): Chosen because team already works in typescript (team.languages); strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=3; shares React/TypeScript skills and code with the React Native (Expo) app; rich client-side interactivity for a ai_ml_product. Mobile - React Native (Expo): Chosen because team already works in typescript (team.languages); strong time-to-market (5/5) with priorities.time_to_market=3; strong cost efficiency (4/5) with priorities.cost=3; strong maintainability (4/5) with priorities.maintainability=3.

React Native scores higher on maintainability and performance (fit 5.3 vs 6.2).
